actions.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select the text and copy it manually

sync.busy: A sync is already running (maybe from the command line). Try again when it finishes.
sync.stopHint: Stops after the file it's on. What's synced so far is kept.

states.backendUnavailableBody: The desktop app couldn't talk to its local database. Try again, or restart {{product}}.
states.crashTitle: Something went wrong on this screen
states.crashBody: Try again, or restart {{product}}. Your data on this computer is not affected.

diagnostics.previewNote: Check that nothing private is in it before sharing.
diagnostics.previewContents: It contains version numbers, sync status and recent log lines. Tokens are removed and course names are replaced automatically.

crash.titleMcp: {{product}} stopped unexpectedly while your AI app was using it
crash.body: It happened {{when}}. Sharing a diagnostic report helps get it fixed.

errors.auth: The token or feed address was rejected. It may have expired or been revoked.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your internet connection and the address.
errors.ambiguous: That matches more than one course.
errors.busy: A sync is already running. Try again when it finishes.
errors.schema_too_new: This data was written by a newer version of {{product}}. Update {{product}} to open it.
errors.schema_too_old: This data is from a version of {{product}} too old to open. Restore a backup from the data folder (the pagelamp.db.v….bak files), or get help in Settings → Help & feedback.
errors.blocked: PageLamp didn't send this to the model.

schema.tooNewBody: Your data was saved by a newer version of {{product}}. Update {{product}} to open it; nothing has been changed.
schema.noUpdate: No newer version is available on your update channel yet. Try again later, or report the problem below.
schema.tooOldTitle: This data is too old to open
schema.tooOldBody: It was saved by a version of {{product}} this one can't upgrade. Restore a backup from the data folder (the pagelamp.db.v….bak files), or get help below.

description.unknown: You haven't recorded this course's rule yet. Your AI app will stick to explaining concepts.
description.prohibited: No generative AI for this course's assessed work.
description.learning_aid: AI can help you understand the material, but not produce graded work.
description.allowed_with_citation: AI can be used for assessed work if you cite or disclose it.
description.unrestricted: The instructor places no restrictions on AI use.

disclosure.title: Privacy
disclosure.short: {{product}} keeps your courses on this computer. Your AI app reads them only when you ask.
disclosure.full: When you ask your AI app about a course, it reads that course's materials from {{product}} and sends them to your AI provider under your own account. {{product}} itself stores nothing remotely. You're responsible for following each course's AI policy — and you can turn sharing off for any course.

canvasNotice: Personal access tokens are for your own use only, and they expire — Canvas shows the maximum when you create one (often 30–90 days).

aiMaterials.label: AI access to materials
aiMaterials.readable_one: {{indexed}} of {{count}} material readable by your AI app
aiMaterials.readable_other: {{indexed}} of {{count}} materials readable by your AI app
aiMaterials.turned_off: AI access to materials is off

pastCourse.hint: Canvas no longer lists this course as active. Its data is kept.

textProblem.no_text: No text found in it: it may be a scan or images only.
textProblem.malformed: It may be damaged, password-protected or in an old format.
textProblem.timed_out: Reading it took too long, so it was stopped. It's tried again when the file changes or the app is updated.
textProblem.cpu_limit: Reading it needed too much processing time, so it was stopped. It's tried again when the file changes or the app is updated.
textProblem.memory_limit: Reading it needed too much memory, so it was stopped. It's tried again when the file changes or the app is updated.
textProblem.crashed: The text reader stopped unexpectedly on it. It's tried again when the file changes or the app is updated.
textProblem.bad_output: The text reader gave an unreadable answer for it. It's tried again on the next sync.
textProblem.spawn_failed: The text reader couldn't start. It's tried again on the next sync.
textProblem.protocol_mismatch: The text reader belongs to another version of {{product}}. It's tried again on the next sync.
